title: Exact composition-retaining molecular rearrangement law
statement: A complete rearrangement retains every atom and held-support occurrence of one connected carrier while a positive finite family of held supports changes exact incidence; every nonoriginal incidence, direct or opened-reclosure path, degenerate trace and unchanged successor remains generated.
generation_rule: Generate the literal product of carrier, atom, support, adjacency, path, alternative, observation and extension coordinates; decide all 256 forms only from admitted Fold conservation, graph and reversible laws.
grammar_boundary: Every positive finite connected source/terminal carrier pair; every exact atom and held support; every nonoriginal target incidence; both direct and opened-reclosure paths; constitutionally degenerate traces; three complete IUPAC records; the preserved first blind surface; all 38 pages and all eight exact Claisen pairs.

choices.name: selected-group-or-product-fragment-only
choices.reason: A fragment cannot prove that the same complete carrier rearranged.

choices.name: complete-source-and-terminal-carrier
choices.reason: The complete connected source and terminal molecular carriers remain explicit.

choices.name: atom-created-erased-or-collapsed-to-formula
choices.reason: A changed atom inventory is a different composition, not a rearrangement.

choices.name: every-atom-occurrence-retained-in-source-order
choices.reason: Every exact atom occurrence remains once in the same carrier.

choices.name: support-created-erased-or-renamed
choices.reason: A replaced bond label cannot be traced through the rearrangement.

choices.name: every-held-support-occurrence-retained-once
choices.reason: Every held support identity remains once while its incidence may move.

choices.name: unchanged-graph-or-unregistered-edit
choices.reason: No change is not a rearrangement and an arbitrary edit is not forced.

choices.name: positive-finite-held-support-incidence-change
choices.reason: At least one held support changes from one exact incidence to another generated incidence.

choices.name: named-mechanism-or-single-imported-order
choices.reason: A conventional mechanism name cannot select the native path.

choices.name: complete-direct-or-opened-reclosure-path-family
choices.reason: The held support moves directly or opens and exactly recloses with its identity retained.

choices.name: species-selected-target-or-degenerate-path-erased
choices.reason: A named product omits other lawful target incidences and constitutionally degenerate traces.

choices.name: all-nonoriginal-incidences-and-degenerate-traces-generated
choices.reason: Every nonoriginal pair is generated and an isomorphic endpoint retains its exact transition trace.

choices.name: product-scope-readable-before-seal
choices.reason: An opened rearrangement scope could choose the survivor.

choices.name: value-free-rearrangement-product-vector-seal
choices.reason: The law, target identities and predicted relation seal before new product vectors open.

choices.name: reaction-specific-exception-or-recomputed-prefix
choices.reason: A named exception is not depth-independent.

choices.name: fresh-unchanged-carrier-successor-no-extra-rule
choices.reason: A fresh unchanged occurrence preserves every prior support move and decision.

induction_base: One retained held support moves from its source atom pair to one different generated pair while every atom, support and unchanged incidence remains explicit and the reverse reconstruction returns exactly.
induction_step: Every next positive finite moved-support family is generated by the same incidence rule; appending a fresh unchanged atom and support preserves the complete prior rearrangement and all decisions.
exclusions: no native numerical zero; structural absence is EmptyOne
no negative irrational imaginary continuum fitted free random or imported native parameter
no reaction name mechanism yield selectivity temperature time mass formula or measured product selects the survivor
all optimization, non-detection, signed stereochemical, spectral, adverse, absent and unresolved rows remain preserved
the first blind incomplete-carrier surface remains unresolved and is never relabelled favorable
conventional imaginary-frequency and signed decimal inscriptions remain downstream evidence only
operational_witnesses: Both endpoints remain complete connected carriers.
Every atom and held support occurrence remains exact.
One held support changes its exact incidence.
Three held supports may rearrange without a new rule.
Every nonoriginal pair is generated for the moved support.
Direct relocation and opened exact reclosure are both retained.
An isomorphic endpoint retains a nonempty exact support-move trace.
The complete rearrangement reconstructs exactly in reverse.
A fresh unchanged occurrence preserves the complete transform.

falsification_condition: The claim fails if more than one generated form survives; any atom, held support, alternative incidence, path, degenerate trace or successor is omitted; any of eight endpoint inventories differs; any pair lacks a positive connectivity change; any page, optimization, non-detection, signed, spectral or first-surface row is omitted; or the external record is allowed to select the law.
